title: X crash site on moon revealed by South Korean orbiter | New Scientist
description: An out-of-control SpaceX rocket that crashed into the moon earlier this week did, in fact, leave an impact crater, according to images from a Korea AeroSpace Administration lunar orbiter that caught before-and-after photographs
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Could geoengineering ‘ice arches’ help preserve Arctic sea ice? | New Scientist
description: Researchers are investigating whether artificially thickening ice blockages between Canada and Greenland could prevent huge amounts of sea ice from flowing south to melt
author: Alec Luhn

title: Drought and heat push Europe's power grid to breaking point | New Scientist
description: High temperatures and low water levels have forced several countries to shut down nuclear reactors just as citizens turn up their air conditioning, forcing energy prices to spike and raising the threat of blackouts
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: 4 ways to watch a solar eclipse without burning your eyes | New Scientist
description: Even during a solar eclipse, it isn’t safe to look directly at the sun, but with a proper solar filter or a simple pinhole projector, you can still watch it disappear behind the moon
author: Leah Crane

title: It’s good for the planet to scrap a new petrol car and buy electric | New Scientist
description: Carbon savings from driving EVs are so large that it makes sense to scrap a working petrol car to make the switch
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: DeepMind AI gives an extra day of warning ahead of deadly cyclones | New Scientist
description: An AI model from DeepMind can predict cyclones three days ahead with a level of accuracy that previous models can only hit a day later
author: Matthew Sparkes
